sources: recreation.gov per-site catalog for facility 233570 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Standard electric sites $30/night all year (2026 rate season, unchanged for 2027); the group shelter with electric $35.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233570/rates (season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' per_night 30, 'GROUP SHELTER ELECTRIC' 35), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233570 (Facilities: 'All campsites have concrete pads, electric, 30 amp and 50 amp, water hookups') + per-site catalog (all 51 standard sites list 50-amp electric and water), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 51 standard electric sites (49 reservable online; 2 not reservable) plus a group shelter. Vehicle limits 30-45 ft, most 40 ft; 3 pull-throughs. Sites 41 and 42 share one pull-through pad, meant for two RVs travelling together (41 may need backing in).

sites.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 233570 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233570 (notice: 'RV site 41 and RV site 42 are pull-through sites that share the same camp pad driveway'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Wi-Fi near the west-end restroom only. Dump station: arriving campers who dump before taking their site pay $20; one RV dump per week of stay, two per 14 days. Large wooden fishing pier; covered picnic table at each site; campers-only picnic pavilion.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233570 (Facilities: 'a sanitary dump station, restrooms with showers, dumpsters, Wifi (near west end restroom only)', 'Laundry Facilities are not currently available on site'; dump-station notices), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bookable on recreation.gov up to the day of arrival (cutoff 0 days). 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days, shared with St. Lucie South (same project). Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.; the entrance gate opens 7:30 a.m. and closes at sunset.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233570 (facility_rules: maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0 days prior to arrival; notices on the shared 14-day limit, check-in/out times and gate hours), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov: $30 standard electric (2026), 50-amp electric + water at all sites, reservable on recreation.gov with a 14-in-30-day limit. Added 51 sites to 45 ft (3 pull-through), showers, dump, wifi (one spot), no laundry. Not stated: sewer, season (rate season is not a season), booking window (left inherited). AWH note kept.
